name: CKEditor5 Pullquote
description: CKEditor 5 toolbar button that wraps selected text in a <pullquote> element (cloned to a floated aside by a frontend behavior) or inserts a standalone <pulledquote>, with optional cite and per-format style variants.
project_description: CKEditor 5 Pullquote adds a Pullquote toolbar button to CKEditor 5. It has two modes. 'Pull from text' wraps the selected passage in a <pullquote> element; a small frontend behavior clones it into a floated <pulledquote> aside next to its parent paragraph, so the original text stays in the body flow while the quote appears as a visual pull-out. 'Custom quote' inserts a standalone <pulledquote> element for an independently authored quote (saved with role="doc-pullquote"). Both modes support an optional cite attribution that is visually hidden in the editor but present in the rendered markup. Odd/even classes are applied automatically to every pulledquote on a page so themes can alternate left/right float direction with CSS alone. Style variants can be configured per text format (one 'class|Label' per line); defined variants appear in the toolbar dropdown and apply a CSS class to the pullquote. The module attaches a minimal frontend stylesheet plus the cloning behavior on every page via hook_page_attachments(). Requires only Drupal core's ckeditor5 module; no external libraries.
